resources.string: Edge swipes: dock, app switcher, drawer and panels

Edge uses this service to draw thin invisible strips along the screen edges so you can swipe from any app: left for the dock, right to switch apps, bottom for the app drawer and top for notifications and quick settings. It also locks the screen on double-tap and notes which app is in front to build the recent-apps list. Edge does not read screen content, and nothing leaves your phone.
